args.text: Can you pull together every site on Marrow Agrisupply you can find across #central-team? List each with where it comes from. Need it before the customer call.

Hi Pree, I went through all of #central-team. Only two Marrow Agrisupply sites are named outright, plus one that's probably Marrow but isn't stated:

1. *Eastbank*: Hollis, 9 Jun 2026, 10:46 AM. Ticket PD-4821 has the Eastbank receiving-door import attached. The file labels doors E1/E2 but their booking sheet uses 01/02, so this needs sorting before anyone reimports, or it will create duplicates.
2. *Pine Crossing*: you, 9 Jun 2026, 10:48 AM. The morning receiver only sees the afternoon shift on the appointment screen. A 7:10 driver arrival got written down on a sticky note. Hollis said he'd check the shift template and get support to reproduce it with the store login.
3. *Wichita store (probably Marrow, not confirmed)*: you, 2 Jul 2025, 9:21 AM. You mentioned "the 8am check-in w the Wichita store dispatcher" right after Tobias said your Zoom was hosting the Marrow Agrisupply office hours. The message doesn't actually say the store is Marrow's, so please check before you use it.

Some things I left out:
• *Tulsa hub* (2 Jul 2025): that's Tansley Parcel, not Marrow.
• *The three "waiting" rows* in Marrow's rollout tracker screenshot (9 Jun): no store names were ever posted in the channel. You said you'd get them from store ops, so you may already have them.

The newest Marrow message in the channel is Hollis's from 9 Jun, so anything after that isn't reflected here.
